/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects1.rsp
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc  -idirafter /home/jmainguy/Github/BaboViolent2/thirdparty/SDL/src/video/khronos -msse3 -msse2 -msse -m3dnow -mmmx -Wshadow -fvisibility=hidden -Wdeclaration-after-statement -Werror=declaration-after-statement -Wall  -O3 -DNDEBUG -shared -o libSDL2.dll -Wl,--out-implib,libSDL2.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,2,--minor-image-version,0 -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive @CMakeFiles/SDL2.dir/linkLibs.rsp
